com.esignal.jstandard.managers

Interface TickHistoryManager

  • All Superinterfaces:
    ResourceManager

    public interface TickHistoryManager
extends ResourceManager
    The TickHistoryManager allows users to request Historical Tick and Intraday Bar data for eSignal symbols.

    Use request to make Tick and Intraday requests. Responses will be delivered to the client application via the HistoricalTickListener.

    Use requestDictionary to request the Flex data dictionary. The client can retrieve the dictionary response from listener's HistoricalTickListener.onDictionaryResponse(DictionaryEvent) method, which will contain a DictionaryEvent . See requestDictionary for more information.

    All of the Historical Tick/Intraday responses are sent to the listener's on***Response() methods. The listener is expected to collect all the information until an onComplete() is called.

    • The listener's onTickRecordResponse, onTickRecordCIDResponse and onIntradayResponse return a HistoricalTickEvent. Use the event's getHistoricalTickList to get the List of HistoricalTickRecord, HistoricalTickRecordCID or HistoricalBar.
    • The listener's onTickRecordFlexResponse and onIntradayFlexResponse return a HistoricalTickFlexEvent. getRecordCount can be used to return the record count. Use the event's iterator to iterate the records. Each record is an iterator of FlexDataFields. An alternative to using the iterator, is to use getSchemaType, getSchema and getByteBuffer and process the response yourself.

    HistoricalTickListener.onComplete is called when the last response has been received successfully and the client will not receive any more responses for this symbol.

    • onComplete(SymbolEvent) is used when HistoricalTickEvent and HistoricalTickFlexEvent are received.
    • onComplete(StatusEvent) is used when DictionaryEvent is received.
    All request calls are treated separately; they do not depend on each other. If the same listener instance is being used on multiple requests, it's recommended to specify different turnaround values.
    Since:
    01-001-0010
    Author:
    ICE Data Services
    See Also:
    HistoricalTickRequest, HistoricalTickListener, HistoricalTickEvent, HistoricalTickFlexEvent, DictionaryEvent

    • Method Detail

      • requestDictionary

        void requestDictionary(int version,
                       HistoricalTickListener historicalTickListener,
                       long turnaround)
        This method is used to make the Flex dictionary request. The client is expected to cache the dictionary. It is recommended to request a dictionary daily in order to stay current with the latest dictionary. Responses may contain a full dictionary or an update that brings the client's specified dictionary version up to the latest dictionary version.
        • When a full dictionary is received, the client should replace their cached dictionary with the full dictionary.
        • When dictionary updates are received, the client should merge the dictionary updates with their cached dictionary.
        • Requests with version 0 will return a full dictionary of the latest version.
        • Requests sent with a non zero version may result in a dictionary update or a full dictionary.
        Client can retrieve the dictionary content via DictionaryEvent. Use DictionaryEvent.isFullDictionary() to check if the response contains a full dictionary or an update. Refer to DictionaryEvent for more details.

        Parameters:
        version - the current dictionary version that the client has cached, or 0 if not cached.
        historicalTickListener - the listener which will process the responses.
        turnaround - the turnaround value for this request.
        Since:
        01-024-0000
        See Also:
        DictionaryEvent

      • request
